questions.q: John's experiment was a great ____.
questions.zh: 約翰的實驗極為成功。
questions.explain: a success（成功的事情）。

questions.q: The rich man is living in a ____ building.
questions.zh: 那富人住在十層樓。
questions.explain: 數字＋單數名詞⇒作形容詞用，ten-story（十層的）。

questions.q: He likes to eat ____.
questions.zh: 他喜歡吃冷凍肉。
questions.explain: fish（魚）、beef（牛肉）為物質名詞，沒有複數；boiling egg（正在煮的蛋）；frozen meat（冷凍肉）；potato 的複數應為 potatoes，fried potatoes（油炸馬鈴薯）。

questions.q: The farmer raises many ____ in his farm.
questions.zh: 農夫在其農場裡養了許多雞。
questions.explain:
① sheep 與 deer 單複數同形。
② ox 複數為 oxen。

questions.q: The servants have removed ____ of this house.
questions.zh: 僕人已移走此屋內的家具。
questions.explain: furniture（家具）為不可數名詞，原不置冠詞，但其後有形容詞片語（of this house）限定，故前置定冠詞 the。

questions.q: Everybody needs at least ____ shoes in his daily life.
questions.zh: 每個人在日常生活中至少需要一雙鞋子。
questions.explain: a piece of（一片／張／塊）；a cake of（一塊）；a pair of（一雙）；a sheet of（一張）。

questions.q: But she always says that we do not listen to any words of ____.
questions.zh: 但她經常說我們不聽她的話。
questions.explain: any words of hers（她的任何一句話）。

questions.q: Many friends of ____ have something to do with that political party.
questions.zh: 我父親的許多朋友與那個政黨有關係。
questions.explain: many ＋ N ＋ of ＋ 所有格代名詞 ➜ 雙重所有格，如 many friends of mine（我的許多朋友）。

questions.q: I met her at ____ the other day.
questions.zh: 我在雜貨店見到她。
questions.explain: 名詞（人）'s ＋ (house, store, shop...)，the grocer's (shop)。

questions.q: What do you think of ____ music abroad?
questions.zh: 瑪麗到國外研究音樂，你覺得如何？
questions.explain:
所有格 ＋ V-ing ＋ 名詞
所有格 ＋ 名詞

questions.q: Man ____ on the earth for thousands of years.
questions.zh: 人類存在地球上已有數千年之久了。
questions.explain:
① Man（人類）＋ 單數動詞
② 表示「一段時間」用現在完成式 has existed。

questions.q: ____ is a faithful animal.
questions.zh: 狗是忠實的動物。
questions.explain:
表示「總稱」用法可用下列三種方式：
A dog is a faithful animal.
＝ The dog is a faithful animal.
＝ Dogs are faithful animals。

questions.q: Last night she went shopping and bought ____ at the market.
questions.zh: 昨天晚上她出去購物，在市場買了一雙手套。
questions.explain:
① a pair of（一雙）
② 成雙的名詞，應用複數，如 shoes, gloves, glasses 等。

questions.q: The news coming from his hometown ____ him feel sad.
questions.zh: 故鄉傳來的消息使他感到悲傷。
questions.explain: 主詞 news 為單數，故用 makes。

questions.q: Language study is one of the best ____ of enabling us to understand our fellow men.
questions.zh: 語言的研究是了解我們同胞的最佳方式之一。
questions.explain: one of the best ＋ 複數名詞（最佳的…之一）。

questions.q: I need to buy a set of new ____ for my living room.
questions.zh: 我需要為我的客廳買一組家具。
questions.explain: tool 與 equipment 為可數名詞，不需要 a set of（一組）來修飾。furniture 為不可數名詞，a set of furniture（一組家具）。

questions.q: Mr. Lin always takes ____ to do his work well.
questions.zh: 林先生總是努力去做妥工作。
questions.explain: take pains（費力；努力）。

questions.q: I did give my parents ____ trouble when I was young.
questions.zh: 年輕時，我的確帶給雙親很多麻煩。
questions.explain: trouble（麻煩）為不可數名詞，用 much 修飾。

questions.q: Machines are ____ no use without the power to run them.
questions.zh: 沒有動力，機械就毫無用處。
questions.explain: of ＋ 抽象名詞 ＝ 形容詞，of no use ＝ useless（無用的）。

questions.q: This book will be ____ in your studies.
questions.zh: 這本書對你的課業有很大助益。
questions.explain:
of great use ＝ very useful（有用的）
with care ＝ carefully（小心的）
of great value ＝ very valuable（有價值的）
of great importance ＝ very important（重要的）

questions.q: Woman is physically weaker than ____.
questions.zh: 女性在身體上比男性弱。
questions.explain: man（男性）；woman（女性）為「總稱」用法。

questions.q: She married while she was still ____.
questions.zh: 她十幾歲時就結婚了。
questions.explain:
① in her teens 在 13－19 歲之間。
② teenager 指 13－19 歲之間的青少年。

questions.q: He went abroad with his parents ____.（複選）
questions.zh: 他在二十(幾)歲時隨父母出國。
questions.explain: in his twenties 指 20－29 歲之間。

questions.q:
"The Smiths have just moved into a larger house."
"Did they have to buy ____ for it?"
questions.zh: 「史密斯一家人已搬到一個較大的房子裡了。」「那他們必須買很多新家具囉？」
questions.explain: furniture 為不可數名詞，不加 s，而且要用 much 修飾。

questions.q: ____ of Confucius are known throughout the world.
questions.zh: 孔子的許多箴言已傳遍世界各地。
questions.explain: many of the ＋ 複數名詞（許多的…）。

questions.q: "I didn't go to the party last night. Did ____ go to the party?"
questions.zh: 「我昨晚未來參加宴會，有很多約翰的朋友參加嗎？」
questions.explain: many John's friends ＝ many friends of John's。

questions.q: His father was a ____. He taught in a university.（複選）
questions.zh: 他父親是個很有學問的學者，他過去在大學教書。
questions.explain: a scholar of learning ＝ a learned scholar。

questions.q: ____ is much better than that.
questions.zh: 我哥哥的這隻表比那隻要好。
questions.explain:
雙重所有格之表達：
This/That/A/Any ＋ N ＋ of 所有格代名詞...

questions.q: His house is within ____ from the railway station.
questions.zh: 他的家離火車站很近。
questions.explain: within (at) a stone's throw（一石之遙；近在咫尺）。

questions.q:
____(1)____ has been widely taught. (2) of people have acquired a good knowledge of (3) language.
（選出第 (1) 題最適當的答案）
questions.zh: 學英語已經很普遍了。非常多的人已學會這種語言。
questions.explain:
(1) 選 (C) English（語言名詞前通常不加冠詞）。
在數字之後的 dozen, hundred, thousand 等不加 s；但如前無明確的數字時，則需改為 thousands (dozens/hundreds) of。

questions.q:
(1) English has been widely taught. ____(2)____ of people have acquired a good knowledge of (3) language.
（選出第 (2) 題最適當的答案）
questions.zh: 學英語已經很普遍了。非常多的人已學會這種語言。
questions.explain:
(2) 選 (A) Many thousands。
在數字之後的 dozen, hundred, thousand 等不加 s；但如前無明確的數字時，則需改為 thousands (dozens/hundreds) of。

questions.q:
(1) English has been widely taught. (2) Many thousands of people have acquired a good knowledge of ____(3)____ language.
（選出第 (3) 題最適當的答案）
questions.zh: 學英語已經很普遍了。非常多的人已學會這種語言。
questions.explain: (3) 選 (C) the（特指前面提到的該種語言，須加定冠詞 the）。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依據中文提示，填入適當的英文字詞

questions.q:
幼年所學，終生不忘。
____ is learned in the cradle ____ ____ of the grave.
questions.zh: 幼年所學，終生不忘。
questions.explain: cradle（搖籃）；grave（墳墓）。全句為：What is learned in the cradle is carried to the grave.

questions.q:
年輕人應該尊敬老年人。
____ should respect ____ ____.
= ____ should respect ____.
questions.answer: The young / the old / Youth / age
questions.zh: 年輕人應該尊敬老年人。
questions.explain:
① the ＋ 形容詞 ＝ 複數名詞
② youth（年輕人），age（老年人）表示總稱用法。

questions.q:
空氣、食物和水為生命所必需。
Air, food and water ____ ____ ____ life.
questions.zh: 空氣、食物和水為生命所必需。
questions.explain: 本句亦可用 are essential to。

questions.q:
貪財為萬惡之源。
____ love of money is ____ root of all ____.
questions.zh: 貪財為萬惡之源。
questions.explain:
① do evil ＝ do wrong（做壞事）
② return good for evil（以德報怨）

questions.q:
忠實乃美德中之至上者。
Faithfulness is ____ ____ of all ____.
questions.zh: 忠實乃美德中之至上者。
questions.explain: Virtue is its own reward.（唯善唯美）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列各句翻譯成英文

questions.q: 據報導，每年有數以千計的青少年犯罪。
questions.hint: ①據報導：It is reported that... ②犯罪：commit crimes
answer: It is reported that there are thousands of juvenile delinquencies every year.
Report has it that there are thousands of juvenile delinquencies every year.
It is reported that thousands of juveniles commit crimes every year.
questions.zh: 據報導，每年有數以千計的青少年犯罪。
questions.explain:
①「據報導」亦可用 Report has it that ＋ S ＋ V。
②「犯罪」亦可用 commit crimes。

questions.q: 這些青少年大部分來自貧困或單親的家庭。
answer: These juveniles mostly come of poor or single-parent families.
These teenagers mostly come of poor or single-parent families.
questions.zh: 這些青少年大部分來自貧困或單親的家庭。
questions.explain:
① mostly（主要地；大半）
② come of（出身於；來自於）

questions.q: 由於無知，他們染上抽煙、賭博、吸毒等惡習。
questions.hint: ①由於無知：out of ignorance ②染上…惡習：addict oneself to
answer: Out of ignorance, they get into bad habits of smoking, gambling, taking drugs, etc.
Out of ignorance, they fall into bad habits of smoking, gambling, taking drugs, etc.
Out of ignorance, they addict themselves to smoking, gambling, using drugs, and so on.
questions.zh: 由於無知，他們染上抽煙、賭博、吸毒等惡習。
questions.explain: 本句亦可寫成：Out of ignorance, they addict themselves to smoking, gambling, using drugs, and so on。

questions.q: 他們白天睡覺，晚上則偷車子或搶劫商店。
questions.answer: They sleep by day and steal cars or rob stores by night.
questions.zh: 他們白天睡覺，晚上則偷車子或搶劫商店。
questions.explain:
「搶劫（人）的（物）」：
rob (人) of (物)
(人) be robbed of (物)
例：I was robbed of my watch the other day.（我的手錶前幾天被搶走了。）

questions.q: 青少年問題日益增多，政府應有效地制止。
questions.hint: ①日益增多：get increasing in number ②制止：curb it
answer: Juvenile delinquency problems are increasing day by day, and the government should take effective measures to stop them.
Juvenile delinquency problems are on the increase day by day, and the government should adopt effective measures to stop them.
questions.zh: 青少年問題日益增多，政府應有效地制止。
questions.explain:
① are increasing ＝ are on the increase（增加）
② take... measures ＝ adopt... measures（採取…措施）

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並選出空格內最適當的答案：

Fast readers have an advantage over slow __1.__. They get through their __2.__ more quickly and in many __3.__ can understand and appreciate more of __4.__ they read.
Some people are slow readers just __5.__ habit. If you are one of these, __6.__ for a while to make yourself read faster. This alone may increase your speed, and after you get used to __7.__, you will not have to force __8.__. Remember that speed is not the most important thing __9.__ reading. Comprehension and appreciation __10.__.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. have an advantage over：超越；勝過
2. get through = finish：完成
3. appreciate [動]：欣賞
4. for a while：暫時；一會兒
5. get used to + N(或)V-ing：習慣於
6. comprehension [名]：了解；理解
7. appreciation [名]：欣賞；賞識

questions.q: Fast readers have an advantage over slow ____.
questions.zh: 閱讀快的人比閱讀慢的人具有優勢。
questions.explain:
① 為避免名詞重複，後面重複的名詞可用 one 或 ones 代替。
② 此句中 ones ＝ readers（讀者）。

questions.q: They get through their ____ more quickly...
questions.zh: 他們更快地完成他們的工作…
questions.explain:
① work [名] 工作（不可數）。
② works [名] 作品（可數）。
③ working hard（動名詞＋副詞）：努力工作；hard work（形容詞＋名詞）：努力工作。

questions.q: ...and in many ____ can understand and appreciate more of (4) they read.
questions.zh: …而且在許多情況下能夠更多地理解並欣賞他們所閱讀的內容。
questions.explain: in many cases：在許多情況下。in case of ＋ N：如果；假如…的話。

questions.q: ...and appreciate more of ____ they read.
questions.zh: …並欣賞他們所閱讀的內容。
questions.explain: what they read 為名詞子句作 of 的受詞。

questions.q: Some people are slow readers just ____ habit.
questions.zh: 有些人讀得慢只是出於習慣。
questions.explain:
① out of habit：由於（出於）習慣性。
② owing to ＋ N：因為；由於。
③ away from ＋ N：遠離；脫離。

questions.q: If you are one of these, ____ for a while to make yourself read faster.
questions.zh: 如果你是其中之一，試著有一段時間讓自己讀快一點。
questions.explain: 本句為「祈使句」，應用原形動詞 try。

questions.q: This alone may increase your speed, and after you get used to ____...
questions.zh: 光是這點就可能提高你的速度，而在你習慣它之後…
questions.explain:
① get used to it：習慣於它。
② it 指 make yourself read faster 這件事情。

questions.q: ...you will not have to force ____.
questions.zh: …你就不用勉強自己了。
questions.explain: force yourself：強迫你自己。

questions.q: Remember that speed is not the most important thing ____ reading.
questions.zh: 記住，在閱讀方面，速度並不是最重要的事。
questions.explain: in ＋ N(或)V-ing：在…方面。

questions.q: Comprehension and appreciation ____.
questions.zh: 理解與賞識才是最重要的。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ Comprehension and appreciation are (the most important things in reading)。重複部分可省略。
